about: E293: every Pavo talking generation on record, labelled PASS/FAIL and diffed prompt by prompt, so pavo_prompt.build writes the prompt that passed (owner 2026-11-03: "Always model the prompt on the way it was done the time it passed"). Nothing generated; read from the probe records, approvals and the E287 eval.

sources.A: migration/evidence/shots/**/<run>.json talking shots (remux records merged into their source generation; genesis-08's closed-mouth voice-over Keeper excluded), approvals migration/production/bible/shots/*.json, E287 eval migration/evidence/pavo-audio-eval/20261103.json
sources.B: flood-ends-long runs 41423359803 and 41436544195 (E266): 10 generations no probe record kept; prompt = the plan at 959a2561^ after episode_build.bind_prompt, outcome FACE_NOT_FOUND on every generation (pavo_lessons 2026-11-02)
sources.C: arc-01-long direct talking probes migration/evidence/pavo/20261027/arc-01-long-talk/probes.json (22 generations); prompt = the plan at 0f4bcaae after bind_prompt; judged on the clip's own track (no E287 re-judgement exists), so its label is the PICTURE only: face and SyncNet sync

label_rule: PASS = approved (bible/shots), or SyncNet sync and face on OUR audio (E287 eval, shot-remux or a pavo_audio ours record: offset -3..0, confidence >= 2.7, face_frames >= 0.8), or a clean legacy probe record (no flag, same thresholds). FAIL otherwise; a native-speech clip with wrong words fails. Cohort C: the same thresholds on the clip track.
findings: Framing decides the face: the Keeper 'Medium shot' 0/10 and 16:9 'Medium close-up' 0/2 lost his face (seated, drawn full body); the right framing for the aspect passed 45/59 (76 %): 16:9/1:1 'Close-up from the chest up, his face large in the centre of the frame', 9:16 and characters 'Medium close-up'.

Binding: every Kokoro-input request went out bound ('Image 1 is the narrator.' + 'speaks the words of the audio clip, his lips moving in sync with the voice', episode_build.bind_prompt), so B differs from the passing prompts by the framing words alone.
Line length: <= 17 words passed 28/36 (78 %), >= 22 words 11/28 (39 %); within the right framing 26/31 (84 %) vs 11/18 (61 %). Pace (words per second) did not separate (75 % vs 73 %).
Aspect: 9:16 7/8, 1:1 9/11, 16:9 29/52; every face loss with the right framing was at 16:9 (4 of 16 chest-up 16:9 Keeper generations).

No variance to test: the scroll in both hands, the campfire flicker, 'holds his head level' and 'looks straight into the camera' are in every Keeper prompt (passing and failing); they stay as they were sent.
A second figure, raised hands and a busy garden background did not lower the rate (75 %, 91 %, 82 %).

Same request, different outcome: arc-02 k-hook/k-close at the identical request digest passed 3/4 in 41629339290 and 0/4 in 41652099686 (two faces lost, two mouths 10-14 windows off our audio): those 4 fails are not a prompt difference.
Extra speech after the last word sits in Pavo's returned track (E282, 'round every was' k-r4 69bfee43); with our audio and the cut at the last word it decided no outcome.

pavo_prompt.build v1 (pavo-talk-v1, E290) was never sent: 0 of 71 generations used its wording (', the speaker centred in the frame', setting before action, 'lips move only while...', 'no hand over the mouth, no head turn away', a one-adjective emotion sentence, no mood sentence), and no generation had its 0.3 s pad.

template.text: Image 1 is {label}. {style} {framing}, static camera. {Label}, {identity}, {pose} {action}, a {emotion} look. {setting} {mood}.{period} {negatives}

framing.16:9: Close-up from the chest up, {pron} face large in the centre of the frame
framing.1:1: Close-up from the chest up, {pron} face large in the centre of the frame

pose.wide: centred in the frame holds {pron} head level and looks {gaze} and

template.action: speaks the words of the audio clip, {pron} lips moving in sync with the voice

input.reference: the speaker's talking reference alone (Keeper ch-keeper-talk), Image 1
input.line_words: 12-17 preferred (84 %), at most 25 (the longest passing line)
input.audio: our exact Kokoro line (E287), cut at the last word in the edit (E273/E282)

template.reproduces: the sent prompts of 17 generations word for word (13 PASS, 4 FAIL; the FAILs: arc-02-noah-compilation-keeper 41652099686 k-hook: on our audio: sync conf 1.135 offset 10; arc-02-noah-compilation-keeper 41652099686 k-hook: on our audio: no face; flood-ends-long 41547308176 k-hook: on our audio: no face; genesis-10-short 41574608645 k-insight: on our audio: sync conf 1.802 offset 0)
